## Subscribe

Daily NBA and WNBA first-basket and prop picks, delivered on Discord — updated every 30 minutes during game&nbsp;days.

### What's included

- **Discord server access** with all picks, updates, and community chat
- **First basket projections** for every game (NBA + WNBA)
- **Full prop markets** — team to score first, tipoff, first assist / rebound / block / steal, and&nbsp;more
- **Auto-updates every 30 minutes** as lines move
- **Daily ROI tracking** — every bet logged, receipts on-server
